# Inter 4.1

Unmodified upright variable font, from the official [Inter repository](https://github.com/rsms/inter/tree/e3a3d4c57d5ecc01453a575621882a384c1995a3).
Source: `docs/font-files/InterVariable.woff2`; licence: `LICENSE.txt`, retained as `Inter-LICENSE.txt`.
SIL Open Font License 1.1. Used for the user-provided Stitch reference typography.
The operations build copies these exact bytes, includes their hashes in vendorSources, and serves the font from the same origin. No font CDN is used.
